data.body: Cluster investigation complete. Root causes: RC-A (infra, hits this + d565-805a/a2e9-4227 only): DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE never exported in any .github/workflows/*.yml (runner.py:789 defaults to 1; suppression branches at runner.py:843/894/922 dead in CI) AND mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh invoked at ci.yml:288 with no stdin producer (script reads DEFENSE_RECORD from stdin per review-github-defense-store.sh:91-102). RC-B (reviewer prompt, hits ee3a-43fc/b2ef-cd72/9e84-2b78 only): Verify-Before-Assert rules exist in reviewer-base.md:66-82 and code-reviewer-light.md:75-91 but LLM disregards them; needs structured verification_evidence field + post-LLM validator + rubric anchors. Both RCs are independent but compound. Complexity: COMPLEX (8+ files / 3 subsystems / 2 RCs). Per fix-bug Phase D Step 2 — escalating to epic via /dso:brainstorm. Do NOT proceed to RED test / implementation in this session. Recommended fix bundle ships RC-A (F1+F2+F3) before RC-B (F4+F5+F6).
